reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Composite resource connection details: Removed: composite resources no longer have native connection details support", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Composite resources no longer have native connection details support; operators relying on it must recreate the feature by composing their own connection details Secret.
consequence.remediation: Compose your own connection details Secret as described in the connection details composition guide.

proposed.statement: Native connection details support for composite resources (XRs) is removed; managed resources keep writeConnectionSecretToRef, and XR users must compose their own connection details Secret.
